findings.title: Auth gate coverage gap
findings.description: Only favorite and message actions gate; offer, chat, apply (jobs/rentals), save search, post wanted, review, report are missing gates despite being in the gated-action contract. Implement gates on all 15 actions listed in the requirements.

findings.title: Market price insight not comparables-based
findings.description: Current implementation shows hardcoded price ranges (±15%) with no actual comparable-listing data. Should pull from DET-06 logic tied to listings in same category/condition/location. Placeholder is acceptable if marked as 'mock' in the UI.

findings.title: Call button lacks privacy implementation
findings.description: DET-04 specifies call should 'respect seller's privacy settings and never show hidden number.' Current implementation passes phone number directly to tel: link with no privacy intermediary. Add intermediate contact gateway or obfuscation layer.

findings.title: Unverified email gate missing
findings.description: AUTH-22 requires unverified social account users and unverified-email registrations to be gate-kicked to OTP screen before posting, messaging, or applying. No evidence of this gate in the code.

findings.title: No rating indicator on contact buttons
findings.description: DET-02 lists 'seller card with badges, rating, response indicators' but contact buttons lack response-time indicators (e.g., 'usually replies in 2 hours'). Indicators are present on seller card sidebar but not on the sticky mobile contact bar.

findings.title: Compare limit enforcement unclear
findings.description: compareList toggles allow up to 3 items in AppContext but form says 'max 4 listings'. Code allows 3; requirement says 3 for vehicles/real estate/electronics. Verify limit and enforce consistently.

blockers: Auth gating incomplete (2 of 15 actions gated)
